svg.text: the rules of the app (Swift package)
ArmorApi, ArmorController, Models: the link to the server and the use cases
ServerEndpoint, Reach, Connector: safe addresses, home and away
DeviceLock, SessionVault, Trust: phone lock, session vault, certificate trust
AlarmPolicy, AlarmText, AlarmCodes: what an alarm asks and how it is worded
MjpegParser, Tr, Resources/i18n: MJPEG cutting and the language tables

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Platform/: Keychain, Face ID, certificate rules, push
Login, Home, Alarms, Cameras, Assistant, More, Locked, Help
Resources/: assets and the permission texts in eight languages
